Start of a Journey (Korean: 여행의 시작 Yeohaeng-ui Sijak) is the first opening theme for the Korean dub of Pokémon Journeys: The Series. It debuted in JN001, replacing Towards the Dream of the Future of Pokémon the Series: Sun & Moon. It uses the same footage as its corresponding Japanese opening theme, One, Two, Three.

The song was uploaded to the official Korean Pokémon YouTube channel on April 2, 2020.

----
 
 
Start of a Journey (Korean: 여행의 시작 Yeohaeng-ui Sijak) is the first opening theme for the Korean dub of Pokémon Journeys: The Series. It debuted in JN001, replacing Towards the Dream of the Future of Pokémon the Series: Sun & Moon. It uses the same footage as its corresponding Japanese opening theme, One, Two, Three.

The song was uploaded to the official Korean Pokémon YouTube channel on April 2, 2020.

==Opening animation==
===Synopsis===
The series logo appears as the camera pans across a large grassy hill and settles on , Goh, , and , who are looking up at the sky. Ash and Pikachu are shown first, with Pikachu climbing around on his shoulders, jumping onto his shirt, and using it as a trampoline. Goh is then seen packing his bag with Scorbunny jumping at his side. Chloe is shown next poking her , which then turns its head and causes Chloe to smile. A cut to Professor Cerise follows, who holds out three s. Ash, Goh, Pikachu, and Scorbunny are shown in front of maps featuring the first partner Pokémon of each of the regions from Kanto to Galar are shown. 

Goh's hands are shown reaching towards a floating yellow orb, which is revealed to be . Goh and Ash are then seen. Their eyes meet before each of them throw a Poké Ball in the air to send out a Pokémon. Ash, Pikachu, Chloe, Goh, and Scorbunny are seen dancing in the Cerise Laboratory, while Yamper lays on the ground in front of Chloe. They then all clap and face the screen. Scorbunny, Pikachu, Ash, and Goh are then seen jumping off a brick terrace away from the lab and run down the street. They trip in front of Chloe, who turns and walks away. Ash and Goh, along with Pikachu and Scorbunny, are then seen gazing up at a rock from which , Jessie, James, and look down and sneer.

Pikachu jumps over a and uses on it. Scorbunny then runs up to a and uses on it. Ash, Pikachu, Ren, Chrysa, Chloe, Professor Cerise, Goh, and Scorbunny all dance and clap their hands. A close-up of Pikachu and Scorbunny is shown, who smile and cry in quick succession. They are shown to be on top of Yamper, who is on top of Mimey. Pikachu and Scorbunny fall off of Yamper and Mimey catches them in each of his outstretched hands before all three jump off.

Ash, Goh, and Chloe, along with their partner , are then seen walking on a rotating Poké Ball past several various Pokémon and landmarks from various regions. and pose together. Pikachu and Ash then jump into view, followed by Goh, Scorbunny, Pikachu, and Ash having tripped, with Goh skinning his knee. Goh and Scorbunny then jump into view, followed by all four seen standing up, looking at each other, and striking a pose.

===TV size===

! English

 

 
 

 
 

 
 
 

 
 
 

 
 

 
 
 

Take hold of the heart where excitement and insecurity coexist, and take the first step

My hopes can't be caught inside fire or underwater
I don't need any consolation on this road where even the next second can't be anticipated

A voice is heard in the street under the warm red sky
Take hold of your heart, let's go! Move it on!

Jump in, let's GO - 1, 2, 3, 4
There's no need to hesitate
Because there are always friends next to me

Come into my world, hey, hold my hand
The fantasy journey I'd dreamt of
An endless adventure into the unknown world

Dangers are hidden over the melodious road spread over the sky
Now I don't avoid them. Throw away all fear

Jump in, let's GO - 1, 2, 3, 4
There's no need to hesitate
Because you, who I've chosen, are inside the imagination of my dreams~
